question.text: `Asha Deep Trust`, a women-empowerment NPO registered under Section 12AB of the Income Tax Act, plans a public issue of Zero Coupon Zero Principal instruments worth INR 2 crore with a 3-year tenure. Which SEBI (ICDR) Regulation specifically governs the public issue of ZCZP?

answer.text: Reg 292D — Public issue of Zero Coupon Zero Principal instrument
Reg 292E — Listing on Social Stock Exchange

explanation.text: The Logic: Within the SEBI (ICDR) framework that governs Social Stock Exchange issuances, the public issue of Zero Coupon Zero Principal instruments by an NPO is regulated under Reg 292D. The associated SEBI operational guidelines specify minimum issue size, minimum subscription and minimum application size as well as conditions on tenure and disclosure for the public issue. Asha Deep Trust's INR 2 crore public ZCZP issue falls under this provision. The Trap: Reg 292B addresses Social Enterprise eligibility (pre-issue). Reg 292C addresses registration with the SSE (step before issue). Reg 292E covers listing conditions post-issue. The provision dealing specifically with public issue of ZCZP is Reg 292D. Note: The cited SIA workbook supports public issuance of ZCZP instruments by NPOs and confirms that issuance conditions are specified by SEBI, but it does not on the pages checked specifically identify Regulation 292D or the minimum issue size, subscription, application size, or three-year tenure figures. The detailed framing above reflects the SEBI ICDR/SSE rule structure rather than a workbook-page citation.
